delete.label: Delete document
delete.confirm: Do you really want to delete the document ?
delete.error: The document could not be deleted.

update.label: Edit document
update.error: The document could not be saved.

create.label: Create new document
create.error: The document could not be saved.

okey.label: okey
okey.helper: The unique ID of the document in the database.

label.label: Label
label.helper: A short description of the image.

url.label: URL
url.helper: The link to the image (usually imgix)

actionUrl.label: Action URL
actionUrl.helper: The link to the action, e.g. to a zoomed image at higher resolution.

altText.label: Alternative text
altText.helper: A short description of the image content for visually impaired people.

overlay.label: Overlay text
overlay.helper: Text to be displayed on the image.

credit.label: Image credit
credit.helper: Attribution of the image. Shown as the source on the image when enabled.

fullPath.label: File path
fullPath.helper: The file path points to the location of the document in storage.

title.label: Title
title.helper: A short description of the document.

mimeType.label: MIME type
mimeType.helper: The MIME type denotes the kind of document, e.g. image/jpg, application/pdf

authorKey.label: Author Key
authorKey.helper: The ID of the author in the database

locationKey.label: Location Key
locationKey.placeholder: The ID of the location in the database
locationKey.helper: This allows a reference of the document to a location.

hash.label: Hash
hash.helper: The hash is a unique, shortened representation of the document's content. It is used for comparisons.

dateOfDocCreation.label: Creation date
dateOfDocCreation.helper: The document was created on this date.

dateOfDocLastUpdate.label: Last update
dateOfDocLastUpdate.helper: The document was last updated on this date.

document_type.name: Document type
document_type.label: Document type
document_type.helper: The type of a document helps with searching.

accounting.label: Accounting
accounting.description: Accounting-related documents, e.g. balance sheet, income statement, annual financial statement, journal, account overview, chart of accounts, etc.

doc.label: Documentation
doc.description: Wiki, standard, report, minutes, memo, book.

hr.label: Human resources
hr.description: Application, job description, CV, authorisation, request, termination, warning, permission.

business.label: Business
business.description: Proposal, study, FAQ, support, analysis, business case.

finance.label: Financial
finance.description: Account statement, income statement, balance sheet, bank statement, receipt, budget, annual accounts, invoice.

legal.label: Legal
legal.description: Contract, offer, licence, NDA, terms and conditions, law, statutes, visa, patent, certificate, passport, ID.

media.label: Media
media.description: Video, audio, graphics, comics, visual, illustration, design, icon, font.

local.label: Local
local.description: The file is part of the application (asset)

storage.label: Storage
storage.description: The file is stored in Firebase Storage (relative URL).

external.label: External
external.description: The file is stored outside the application (absolute URL to a file share, e.g. Google Drive, Dropbox).
